top_signals.title: USS Theodore Roosevelt becomes first carrier with built-in Unmanned Air Warfare Center
top_signals.summary: The USS Theodore Roosevelt is now the first Navy carrier to be equipped with an Unmanned Air Warfare Center that will support the unmanned MQ-25A Stingray.

top_signals.title: Lawmakers want Postal Service bonuses tied to delivery performance
top_signals.summary:
A bill banning bonuses for U.S. Postal Service leaders for failing to meet on-time delivery standards passed a Senate committee and a similar measure was recently proposed in the House.

top_signals.title: Global Gas Turbine Orders Hit Record High as Power Demand Surges
top_signals.summary: Global orders for gas turbines have hit a record high as demand for power generation surges, according to JP Morgan. New gas turbine orders in the second quarter stood at 38 GW, which was 29% higher than orders in the first quarter of the year, the bank said, as quoted by Bloomberg. The increase in second-quarter orders was much higher on an annual basis, too, at 71%, JP Morgan also reported.
